'dzam bu gling pa'i yul khams dang mi rigs rus rnam dbye bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 'dzam bu gling pa'i yul khams dang mi rigs rus rnam dbye bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa sti/ srid pa'i gter kha bang mdzod 'dzoms pa'i mthus/ /mi srid bya ba gang yang med pa'i phyir/ khams gsum gling bzhi khyad par rgya bod na/ /yul grangs mi rigs rnam 'gyur 'di ltar snang*/ /de'ang lho 'dzam bu gling pa yul 'gras klagrubluche chung dang*/ mtha' dbus kyi ngos 'dzin/ mi rigs/ skad rigs kyi rnam dbye mang du bstan cing*/ khyad par dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs/ yul gyi dbus rgya gar rdo rje gdan la ngos 'dzin pa mang la/ mdo rgyud nas kyang bshad pa ni chos dar 'baklasablayin pa la dgongs so/ /'dzam bu gling gi sa tshad dang yul khams kyi dbye gnas bstan pa lugs gcig la/ 'dzam gling sog kha 'di dbyibs shing rta lta bu sog pa'i yu ba lcags 'arigs klaritngos la bstan pa la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi dang*/ gzhan phyogs gsum la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis so/ /de'i shar gyi gling g.yog rnga yab na/ ljon pa rta mgo can gyi rgyal khams yod cing*/ nub kyi rnga yab gzhan la/ yaksha sṛn po'i rgyal khams yod de/ gling g.yog gnyis po'ang dbyibs gong dang 'dra zhing*/ rgya ni gling che ba'i phyed ma'i tshad do/ /'dzam gling 'di la yul 'grasaklagrubluchen po dgu yod par 'dod de/ shar na rgya nag dang khri bstan/ lho na rgya gar dang kha 'phyeklacheblu/ nub na stag sde dang*/ gzigs 'phan/ byang na khrom dang*/ ge sar gnyis | dbus na bod yul gangs kyi ra ba dang dgu zer ste/ 'dzam gling gi sa tshad kyi lte ba/ bod gangs 'cheklacanablu'adi yin par 'dod pa ni/ sa mtho/ ri mang | gangs chags/ chu 'a'o klabobluthams cad 'di nas phyi mtha' rnams la babs pa'i phyir gyis/ 'di nyid sa'i dbus lte ba yin par 'dod do/ /bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams dang*/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal khams kyi mtshams na/ srid pas bskos pa'i rdau ring chen po bzhi yod de/ shar phyogs rgya nag po dang bod kyi sa mtshams sha phud gangs dkar lha'i yul na/

'gron bu dung gi rdau ring btsugs pa yan chad/ lho phyogs rgya dkar po dang*/ bod kyi so mtshams snyug ma bu khur srin gyi mthing shun/ g.yu'i rdau ring btsugs pa tshun chod/ nub phyogs stag gzig dang bod kyi so mtshams/ skang ma skang gcig klu'i yul na/ sha tshe dngul gyi rdo ring btsugs pa man chad/ byang phyogs khrom ge sar dang bod kyi so mtshams ma sma'i lu rgyud sman gyi yul na/ ra gan gser gyi rdau ring btsugs pa tshun chad/ de rnams bod kha ba can gyi sa tshad du rtogs par byed cing*/ rdau ring bzhi po de la/ sbom phra pho 'dom lnga cu'i 'khor dang*/ dpangs la pho 'dom gnyis brgya re yod par byed do/ /bod la yul gru chen po gsum yod pa ni/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba rdzing dang 'dra ba la yul gru chen po gcig smad lha ri chu drug la/ nags dang ne'u ljong zhing dang 'dra ba yul gru chen po gcig bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi brag dang chu 'thab pa yur ba dang 'dra ba la yul gru chen po gcig te / de gsum mo/ /dang po bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams zer cing*/ bar skabs su lha srin mang po'i 'dzin pa'i dus na/ gdong dmar can gyi yul zer ba'ang byung / de rting bod rgyal gri gum btsan po'i sras/ bar pa bya khris/ spu bo brag thog tu byon/ spu bo'i rje mdzad/ rting la yar gdan drangs| spu de gung rgyal bya bar mtshan gsol/ bod kyi rgyal por bskos/ de'i mnga' zhabs su gyur phyin na/ spur rgyal bod kyi yul bya ba 'di byung bar gda'o// rgya dkar po'i yul de/ dar dkar gyi yol ba brkyangs pa dang 'dra/ rgya nag po'i yul| mkhris pa gcong la bskyur ba dang 'dra/ bal po'i yul gzhong pa dang 'dra ba/ zhang zhung yul bshang kha'i sbubs 'dra/ lho kha bzhi ra skor 'dra/ 'arkong klakongablupo'i yul bre 'dra/ bod zal mo'i sgang 'dra ba zer ba rgyal rabs khugs pa thugs rje chen po'i yang tig las gsungs so/

/'dzam bu gling na rgyal khams che chung bcu gsum yod pa'i / ming ngos can gyi 'dzin pa lnga ni/ rgya gar chos kyi rgyal khams/ rgya nag rtsis kyi rgyal khams/ stag gzig nor gyi rgyal khams | khrom ge sar dmag gi rgyal khams/ bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams dang lnga'o/ /༈ mi ma yin pas 'dzin pa'i rgyal khams brgyad ni/ og ma sbal 'byar rgyal khams/ the rings mig gis rgyal khams/ skyer chab smai sha can gyi rgyal khams | sog po spre'u lag can gyi rgyal khams/ rgya mo khri khyo can gyi rgyal khams/ tshe tshe ra mgo can gyi rgyal khams/ sna bo che bong bu'i rgyal khams/ tsu ta rkang gcig pa'i rgyal khams dang brgyad do/ /zhib par phye na/ 'dzam bu gling pa la/ mi rigs mi 'dra ba sum brgya drug cu | skad rigs mi gcig pa bdun brgya nyi shu/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu bdun| rus pa lces 'gyur tshad gcig ming kha nas thon tshad gcig yod par bshad na'ang*/ rus kyi phyi mo bcu gnyis tsam la bsdus so/ /de la rgyal rigs rnams che ba/ rje rigs rnams mthun pa/ bram ze'i rigs rnams gtsang ba/ dmangs rigs rnams mang ba dang bzhi las/ spyi'i rigs bzhi zer te/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rigs thams cad 'di bzhir 'dus so/ /bar gyi rigs bzhi ni/ rgya gar ba lha las chad pa/ saṃskri ta lha'i skad du smra/ rgya nag pa klu las chad pas/ na ga tri ta klu'i skad du smra/ hor lha ma yin las chad pas/ a su tri ta lha ma yin gyi skad du smra/ bod spre'u dang brag srin mo las chad pa ni/ a wa bhraṃ sha tri ta 'dre'i skad du smra ba dang bzhi'o/ /nang gi rigs bzhi ni/ stong dang*/ ldong dang*/ se dang*/ rmu rnams te/ 'di bzhi las bod mi phal che ba gyes par bshad pas/ 'di rnams la rus kyi phyi mo bcu gnyis zhes grags/ /yang lugs gcig la/ phyi'i mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ spang phug gi phyi ba dang*/ ko kyong gi sbal pa dang*/ spra dang*/

spre'u de bzhi'o/ /nang gi mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ gam shang rgya dang*/ gyim shang hor/ kha le mon| spu rgyal bod dang bzhi'o/ /de'i nang nas/ rgya la grol cha gnyis su gyes pa ni| rmu rus dang*/ ke la'o/ /hor la yang gnyis su gyes pa ni/ srin tsha dang*/ lha tsha'o/ /mon la rigs gsum byung ba ni/ mon rang rgyud pa dang*/ rgya bod mtshams kyi mi nyag kaung po dang gsum mo/ / bod la mi'u 'argyudaklagadung bludrug tu grol te/ de yang bod khams pa'i lugs la/ sngon yul rma kha shu g.yag shur bya ba'i gong khar/ srid pa rgya lu thing ge zhes pa la bu gsum byung ba la rgya bod hor gsum du gyes pa'i/ bod mi khri tho chen po bya ba de la bu drug byung ba ni/ dbra 'bru ldong gsum lga dang bzhi/ nu bo was dha gnyis dang drug bod kyi mi bu 'argyud klagadungabludrug des| rma kha shu ras 'a'adebs klaldebasablustag bya ba der/ bod ma gsum bu drug sa bgos byas/ dbra'i phra mo rab phra thob/ 'bru'i 'bru mo khrom khrom thob/ sdaung gi pa ma le sang thob/ lga'i sgar ma me po thob/ dbra sdes rgya bod so mtshams su/ mtshams kyi mda' ra gong ma bzung*/ de la che rgyud gong nas ma shor ba/ pho bo sdong gi bu rgyud yin/ mthu chen dam tshig ma nyams pa/ se khyung dbra'i bu rgyud yin| | dpa' rgya stag mche sder ma nyams pa/ a cag 'bru'i bu rgyud yin/ phyugs g.yang mo'i mkhal tshil ma zhu ba/ dmu tsha lga'i bu rgyud yin/ /pho bo ldong la che drug yod/ stod na pa tshab 'a'aphring kla'abringablu g.yas gnyis/ /bar na ro che rag shi gnyis/ /smad na mi nyag gyi then gnyis/ /che drug 'chan gyi btsun drug de| |gi ri mdo dang gling ba gnyis/ /ro rje phu dang 'da' ba gnyis/ / gyi than rgyas bsdus che chung gnyis/ /de che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin/ /se khyung dbra la 'chad drug yod/ /stod na zhang zhung khyung po gnyis/ /bar na mar pa spu rang gnyis/

/smad na re khe nyag le gnyis/ /'chad drug 'chan gyi btsun drug de// kri la rme sha rme tshan gnyis/ /brag ru la gu rdo nye gnyis/ /nyag le kho po kho 'dre gnyis| |che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin/ khri zam 'bru'i che drug de/ / shar na king dang rong po gnyis/ /lho na bhe dang ri thog gnyis/ /smad na 'grom dang ngo gro gnyis/ /'chad drug 'chan gyi btsun drug de/ /a dang spos dang tsha khrom gsum| |zhugs pa bstod nye nyer gre gsum/ /che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin | | rmu tsha sga'i 'chad drug de/ /thod rus stag tu stod na yod/ /bya can khrab tsan stod na yod/ /bya che span ston stod na yod/ /'chad drug 'chan gyi btsun drug de/ /sga la gyes pa yul sa gnyis/ /bstan rus yul stag 'grog sta gnyis// dbas la che skor chung skor gnyis/ /che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yod// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/yul khams dang mi'i rigs rus rnam dbye bshad pa/ -PAGE 10--PAGE 9-
